value.rationale: Adjacency and nonbacktracking spectral radii are both standard network quantities used in spreading and percolation threshold analysis. Fixing both order and size removes simple density explanations. The exact first reversal therefore gives a natural diagnostic boundary for when two widely used spectral vulnerability surrogates can recommend opposite network rankings.
